intro: [The Biohackers World Conference & Expo](https://www.biohackers.world/) offering attendees a transformative experience in the realm of biohacking and wellness optimization. Hosted by a thriving community of experts and like-minded individuals, this event promises to elevate your wellness journey through cutting-edge health tech and life extension strategies.

blocks.text: Attendees can expect a weekend filled with insightful sessions, collaborative opportunities, and connections with fellow biohackers. Highlights of the event include:

items: • Explore Wellness Science: Gain expert guidance and strategies to optimize your health and well-being.
• Collaborate and Grow: Build partnerships and client relationships within the biohacking community.
• Connect with Fellow Biohackers: Expand your network and engage with like-minded individuals passionate about wellness empowerment.

blocks.text: The conference will feature over 30 biohacking and health visionaries, offering inspiring keynotes and mind-refreshing performances. Attendees will also have the opportunity to explore 25+ biohacking and wellness innovators at the Expo Zone.

CEO and Founder of [The Root Brands](https://therootbrands.com/)[**Clayton Thomas**](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/clayton-thomas) will join us as a keynote speaker, sharing insights on biohacking and wellness journey. The Root Brands, a trailblazing wellness company, will serve as the Title Sponsor for the event. The Root Brands harnesses nature’s power to unlock the body, mind, and spirit’s potential, offering natural solutions such as “Give Me Back My Youth” for anti-aging, “The Trinity” trio for holistic cleansing and focus, and “Immune Defense Shield” for cell health. Embracing a holistic approach, The Root Brands is your partner in the journey to optimal well-being.
It’s a chance to meet an impressive lineup of top speakers who will deliver keynote speeches on biohacking, longevity, sport and sleep optimization, intimacy, and much more!

“We’re thrilled to bring together a diverse community of biohackers and wellness enthusiasts for this one-of-a-kind event,” said [Mick Safron](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/mick-safron), Founder and CEO of Biohackers World. “The Biohackers World Conference & Expo is where innovation meets inspiration, and we invite everyone to join us in shaping the future of wellness.”

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to unlock your potential and embark on a journey towards a healthier, happier you. Reserve your spot now for the **Biohackers World Conference & Expo in Austin, Texas** .
Kate, the PR Manager of Biohackers World

The Biohackers World Conference & Expo is a premier event in the field of biohacking and wellness optimization. Bringing together experts, innovators, and enthusiasts, the conference offers a platform for collaboration, growth, and transformation in the dynamic world of health technology.

The Root Brand is a leading company in the field of wellness and longevity. CEO and Founder Clayton Thomas is a respected figure in the biohacking community, dedicated to empowering individuals to optimize their health and well-being.
